The plate is roughly 26 cm across, so I sized each piece against that. The photo shows two partial slices of thin-crust cheese pizza. Each slice is about 9 cm long and 7 cm wide at the base, and the crust looks thin, about 0.8 cm.

Each slice has a footprint of about 50 cm² and a thickness of roughly 0.8 cm including toppings. That gives a volume of about 40 cm³. Pizza is fairly dense at about 0.6 g/cm³ once cooked, so each slice weighs about 25–30 g. I split the total into crust and cheese/sauce.

- **Pizza (crust, sauce, cheese):** two slices at about 28 g each is about 56 g. At around 270 kcal per 100 g, that is the main item.
- **Cheese:** it is melted and browned directly on the pizza, so I am counting it inside the pizza figure rather than as a separate layer.
